Tone: Isolated, intellectual, the past reaching into the present. Tinged with horror.

Checks Switch 1130 (SYNTH_FORK_CHOSEN), 1131 (SYNTH_GIOVANNI_PATH),

Sets Switch 1155 (SYNTH_MANSION_JOURNALS) ON after encounter.
